description: Janela: acumulado e ranking por UF, anterior e % do total.
sql:
WITH "v" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM READ_PARQUET('Vendas.parquet')
), "w" AS (
  SELECT
    "uf",
    "cidade",
    "data_txt",
    "preço_txt",
    "quantidade",
    "data_venda",
    "valor",
    "ativo",
    CAST(SUM("quantidade") OVER (
      PARTITION BY "uf"
      ORDER BY "data_venda" ASC
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS BIGINT) AS "acum",
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "uf" ORDER BY "data_venda" ASC) AS BIGINT) AS "n",
    LAG("cidade", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "uf" ORDER BY "data_venda" ASC) AS "anterior",
    CAST(CAST("quantidade" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM("quantidade") OVER (PARTITION BY "uf"), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS "pct"
  FROM "v"
), "s" AS (
  SELECT
    "uf",
    "cidade",
    "acum",
    "n",
    "anterior",
    "pct"
  FROM "w"
), "o" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM "s"
  ORDER BY
    "uf" COLLATE NOCASE ASC,
    "n" ASC
)
SELECT
  *
FROM "o"
result:
